alt: Ten students in smart-casual clothes standing together in front of a carved wooden wall, one giving a thumbs-up.
About fifteen students posing on a tree-lined campus street, a few of them pulling faces at the camera.
A group selfie of about fifteen students around a long wooden table set for hot pot, in a log-walled room.
A group selfie of nine students at a restaurant table covered in burgers and fries, under colourful bar lights.
A dozen students in gowns and suits posing together at an evening formal.
Four students in formal dresses and blazers smiling together at an evening formal.
Five students in suits and ties with their arms around each other at an evening formal.
Six students laughing as they stack themselves into a human pyramid in a wood-beamed cabin.
Four students in a red canoe paddling through a metal culvert, one holding a paddle in the air.
About twenty students in winter jackets posing for a group photo on the grass in front of a forest.
A row of students behind a bar hung with paper streamers, under a red sign that reads Love Fest. One wears an NUS Social Committee shirt.
